author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Play on Tabletop is sponsoring this episode! We're excited to be at Game Con Canada again this year and we are hoping to bring as many members of the Play on Team as we can! We will be running 2 King of the Colosseum tournaments. Friday will be a fast and furious with a single battle in each round. On Saturday, each round will be a best of 3 just like you've seen on the channel! 

Get your tickets https://www.tixr.com/groups/gameconcanada/events/play-on-tabletop-warhammer-40-000-narrative-tournament-2026-159019 before they're all gone!

We're celebrating the coronation of a new King in the Colosseum by pitting Jordan against the previous champions! Jordan is going up against Tak and Nick, the winners of Seasons 1 and 2, to see if he can bring down the previous champions in this special Coronation episode!
